prompts.name: portrait
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: flagship high-resolution illustrated VTuber character, clean transparent PNG cutout, portrait 2:3 canvas. This will be the actual in-app character artwork, not a mockup or a poster.
Primary request: ONE original, exceptionally polished professional anime VTuber model, the artistic finish of a top-tier commissioned Live2D character illustration. Upgrade the existing concept of Miya, an adult lavender-haired cat-eared anime streamer, into a beautifully art-directed premium character.
Subject: a clearly adult elegant anime woman, softly confident warm smile with closed lips, straight-on neutral symmetrical standing pose, direct forward gaze. Full head and ears down to upper thighs visible, arms relaxed at her sides and fully within canvas. Attractive refined anime proportions, delicately shaped face, large expressive luminous turquoise eyes with intricate layered iris detail, finely tapered eyelashes, delicate eyebrows, subtle warm blush and gentle skin shading.
Hair: long flowing pale silver-lavender hair with deeper violet underlayers, beautifully separated overlapping locks, silky directional highlights, wispy face-framing strands, subtle thin teal accent strands; softly furred lavender cat ears. Asymmetrical ornate moon-shaped hair clasp with tiny cyan gemstone and fine chains.
Costume: cohesive bespoke midnight-indigo and ivory celestial-tailored outfit; high collar, fitted structured embroidered bodice, cropped shoulder capelets, translucent pleated sleeve details, intricate silver thread filigree, fine lace edging, small faceted turquoise gemstone at throat, delicate gold-silver chains, beautiful intentional fabric folds and seams. Elegant and practical stream character, fully clothed, no exaggerated anatomy, no cleavage focus. Ornament should be beautifully hierarchical rather than visual noise. Every material reads distinctly: satin, woven fabric, lace, polished metal, gem facets.
Style: masterful crisp hand-inked anime linework with varied fine line weight, sophisticated multi-step cel shading blended with delicate painterly gradients, outstanding bespoke character design, premium 2D Japanese VTuber promotional/model artwork. Not 3D, not realistic, not flat vector, not chibi, not simplistic mascot. Rich microdetail visible at high resolution, face remains the focal point. Exactly one character.
Composition: strict front view, centered upright head with no tilt or turn, neutral symmetrical rigging-ready pose, generous 6% clear margin around ears, hair, elbows and entire silhouette; no objects in hands; entire lower cropped edge horizontally at upper thighs. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, maximum detail/resolution, aim 2048x3072.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into the image.
Constraints: no text, lettering, signature, logo, watermark, frame, UI, extra people, props, surrounding particles or detached decorative stars. The artwork alone on transparency. Keep eyes open and mouth softly closed so expression layers can be made afterward.

prompts.name: face-underpaint
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the EDIT TARGET, not merely a reference. Create a rigging underpaint for this exact anime VTuber illustration.
Preserve the exact original 1024x1536 canvas, the character's position, scale, face silhouette, hair, ears, jewellery, body, clothing, colors, shading and every other pixel's appearance as closely as possible.
Change ONLY the facial eye/eyebrow/mouth features: carefully erase both complete eyes (including iris, whites, lashes and upper eyelid), both eyebrows, and the mouth/lips, replacing those small regions with smoothly continuous natural skin matching the surrounding exact skin tones and lighting. Keep the nose, face outline, subtle cheek blush, every hair strand, the chin and the earrings unchanged. This is a featureless face skin underpaint for independently animated eye/mouth layers to be drawn on top. Do not move or reshape the face.
Keep the original transparent alpha background; no backdrop, no gradient, no checkerboard, no added shadows. No text, no labels. Return the full original-size image with just these small facial-feature removals; everything else must match exactly.

prompts.name: body
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is an EDIT TARGET for exact rigging layer extraction. Keep 1024x1536 canvas and exact original character alignment, scale, clothing design and texture.
Create ONLY the torso/body layer of this same anime VTuber: retain the high dark neck collar at y≈405, elaborate gem brooch, shoulders, complete embroidered ivory/navy outfit, sleeve capelets, both arms and hands, waist, skirt and thighs in exactly their original positions.
REMOVE the entire head, face, ears, all lavender hair and all turquoise hair strands, and hair jewellery. These removed regions must be transparent alpha. The area above the neck collar must be completely transparent. Where flowing hair used to cross in front of the costume/shoulders/sleeves, faithfully reconstruct the hidden matching fabric, skin and embroidered details, so this body layer is complete underneath the hair. Do not change the neckline or outfit design. Keep the high collar covering the neck base.
This is a single clean rigging body cutout, not a reference sheet. The arms, shoulders and lower silhouette must retain exact original geometry and original canvas coordinates. No text, no labels, no new objects, no background, no cast shadow, no backdrop. Preserve transparent alpha.

prompts.name: head-hair
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET for a layered animated character.
Extract ONLY the HEAD AND HAIR as a transparent full-size rigging layer. Keep the EXACT 1024x1536 canvas, exact original head position, exact original scale. Do not recenter or enlarge. Ears remain at the top; the face stays at x≈512,y≈280. All the original lavender hair including the long flowing locks and braids and cyan accent strands, both cat ears, moon clasp, dangling hair ornaments and jewellery should remain in the exact original places with their fine linework and shading.
REMOVE the entire outfit, collar, torso, shoulders, chest, arms, hands, legs, skirt and all body below the chin; those regions must be transparent alpha. Keep the face and chin fully; keep the face featureless exactly as in this image (eyes, eyebrows and lips are intentionally absent for animation); preserve the nose and skin shading. The neck area just below chin can extend a little as natural skin, but no clothing.
Where the original costume occupied the central area below the chin there must now be a large transparent opening between the long hair locks. Do not invent solid sheets of hair over the former body. Preserve distinct wispy front locks that originally fell over shoulders and chest, with their transparent gaps.
This is a cutout, not a new composition. No backdrop, no floor, no shadow, no checkerboard, no text. Real transparent alpha. Keep the hair illustration crisp and intricate. Preserve alignment critically.
